headline: HuyenBao v11.28 — Đấu giá & rao bán THEO THỜI GIAN (có thể không bán được!) + menu Tài sản đưa lên đầu + tổng quan ghim cùng tuổi
summary: TIMED MARKETPLACE + ASSETS FIRST. The instant auction is GONE: putting an item up now TAKES TIME — AUCTIONS run 4–7 game-days with bids rolling in one by one (the hammer can land above the ask in a bidding war) while fixed-price LISTINGS run 8–12 days with steadier odds; both can find NO buyer, in which case the item comes back and the upfront fee (3% auction / 1.5% listing) is forfeited. Items live at the market while listed (removed from inventory, still counted in net worth) and you can withdraw early. The exact sell chance is shown before you commit: 1−(1−p)^days, scaled by rarity — legendary draws watchers, common barely sells. The Assets tab is now a 5-section menu (Auction house / Used market / Rare items / Workshop / Shop) with live badges, and the Assets GROUP moved up to slot 2 in the main nav right after Character. The v11.27 attention strip (cash / net worth / income-per-year / health + warnings) merged with the age card into one COMPACT PINNED bar (position:sticky) that follows you on every tab. Full EN/VI/ZH localisation including auction-result toasts. 8 new engine tests cover the timed marketplace.
features: AUCTION: put items up for 4–7 days — per-day bid rolls, hammer can exceed the ask (bidding war), 3% upfront fee, no buyer = fee lost + item returned
LISTING: fixed-price sale for 8–12 days — steadier odds (p×0.75/day), 1.5% upfront fee, sells exactly at the ask
SELL CHANCE PREVIEW: exact 1−(1−p)^days shown per item before committing (legendary ~71% on a 5-day auction vs common ~43%)
MARKET JOBS: items leave the inventory while listed, keep counting toward net worth at their ordinary value, withdrawable anytime (fee forfeited)
LIVE JOBS UI: countdown in days, best bid so far, exact sell chance, one-tap withdraw
ASSETS SUB-MENU: Auction house / Used market / Rare items / Workshop / Shop with count badges; rare section shows your collectibles + all rare/legendary catalogue items
NAV: Assets group moved UP to slot 2 (right after Character) per UX feedback
PINNED OVERVIEW: age card + attention strip merged into one compact sticky bar (cash / net worth / income / health chips + warning line + slim life track) visible on every tab
TOASTS: auction/listing results localised EN/VI/ZH (up for auction, sold with bids, no buyer, withdrawn)
TESTS: 8 new engine tests for the timed marketplace; 151 tests total
Version bumped to v11.28 at FRONT of app name
